topics.title: Find the night on setlist.fm
topics.body: Tap + on Shows, then Search setlist.fm. Pick the band, then the night you were there. The setlist comes with it.

topics.title: Add a show by hand
topics.body: Tap + and Add by hand: band, venue and date. If the band has a setlist archive, the setlist fills in by itself.

topics.title: Scan a ticket
topics.body: Tap + and Scan a ticket, then take or pick a photo of a ticket stub, wristband or mobile ticket. Check each show it finds before adding it. Scanning needs an account.

topics.title: Shows you have tickets for
topics.body: Tap + and Add an upcoming show. They're under Upcoming on Shows. After the night, tap I went and it moves to your shows with its setlist.

topics.title: Import a list
topics.body: Tap + and Import shows to bring in a spreadsheet (.csv or .xlsx) or a screenshot of past events. Match the columns, check the list, then import.

topics.title: Adding without a connection
topics.body: A show you add offline waits under Waiting to sync and is added when you're back online.

topics.title: Past and Upcoming
topics.body: Shows has your past shows by year and the ones coming up. Tap a show to open it.

topics.title: Rate the night
topics.body: On a show, rate the show and the venue from 1 to 10 and add a note. Only you see your note. Every note you've written is in Me under Your notes.

topics.title: Rate songs
topics.body: Tap a song to rate it or write about it. Rate unrated goes through the songs you haven't rated yet.

topics.title: Fix the setlist
topics.body: Add a song, move one or take one out from the setlist, and undo if you change your mind. When a source has a newer setlist, the show offers it for you to accept or skip. Your ratings are never lost.

topics.title: Photos, videos and comments
topics.body: Add photos and videos from the night, and talk about the show with other people who were there. These need an account.

topics.title: Relive this night
topics.body: On the anniversary of a show, Shows brings it back. The anniversary calendar is in Notifications.

sections.title: Stats, Year in Review and posters

topics.title: All time or one year
topics.body: Stats shows all time or a year you pick: totals, your top bands, songs and venues, and shows by month. Tap a band, song or venue to see those shows.

topics.title: Year in Review
topics.body: Pick a year on Stats, then Your year in review: your top bands and songs, rare ones, your show buddy, highlights and a card to share.

topics.title: Songs
topics.body: All your songs is on Stats. A song's page shows every time you've seen it, the gaps between them and where it landed in the set.

topics.title: Your poster
topics.body: On a band's page, Make my poster draws every song you've heard them play, ready to share. For Goose, Phish, Umphrey's McGee and King Gizzard it opens the Songs I've heard tool, with your rarest catches.

topics.title: Add friends
topics.body: On Friends, add someone by their handle or send an invite. Requests wait there for you to accept.

topics.title: Tag friends at a show
topics.body: On a show, tag the friends who were there. They confirm it, and the show appears in Shows together.

topics.title: Activity and notifications
topics.body: Friends shows what your friends have been adding and rating. Turn sharing your own activity on or off in Me. The bell has your notifications.

topics.title: Search your shows
topics.body: The Search tab searches your own shows by band, venue, city, song, date and rating. Save a search you use often; recent ones are kept too.

topics.title: Library
topics.body: Tours, Runs, Festivals, Wishlist, Bucket List and Setlist Photos are at the top of Me.

topics.title: Your profile
topics.body: Set your name and claim a handle. Turn on a public profile to give your shows a page at mysetlists.net/u/your-handle, and use Preview to see what strangers would see first.

topics.title: Bands you follow
topics.body: Follow a band from its page to hear about tours and on-sales. Choose which alerts you get in Alert settings.

topics.title: Feedback and the roadmap
topics.body: Send feedback from Me. Ideas from accounts go on the roadmap for review, and you can vote for the features you want.

topics.title: Using MySetlists as a guest
topics.body: As a guest, your shows are kept on a guest account tied to this phone. Create an account to keep them for good and use them anywhere. Your shows come with you.

topics.title: What needs an account
topics.body: Ticket scanning, friends, comments, photos, a public profile and anything other people see need a free account.

topics.title: Your data
topics.body: Request a copy of your data or delete your account at the bottom of Me.

topics.title: Report and block
topics.body: Every comment, photo and profile can be reported. Block someone and their content disappears from your app at once. Blocked accounts are listed in Me.
